text:
Devin: heads-up: when I drag a rule across collapsed groups, the drop target is ambiguous — preview doesn't show where it'll land. cc @Sam @Lexa
Marta: saw that. repro steps?
Devin: 1) collapse Group B 2) drag rule from Group A down past collapsed group 3) ghost drops on top of Group B header but preview still shows inside Group A — :confused:
Sam: ah ok. that's the ghosting logic. We snap to nearest visible group header when collapsed; preview uses underlying index. bug: drop indicator vs final index mismatch.
Tyler: priority reorder mismatch is scary for users. Could cause wrong routing. High risk.
Lexa: also screen reader announces 'moved to group' but doesn't announce position in list — for keyboard-only users it's impossible to know exact rank.
Devin: proposed fixes: a) show persistent 'target index' tooltip while dragging b) when group collapsed, expand briefly in preview on hover c) add microcopy 'Hold Shift to reorder across collapsed groups' (or mirror depending on final interaction).
Sam: implementation notes: expanding on hover is heavy. We can instead show thin blue insertion line next to header and in preview show highlighted slot. tooltip easy. will need backend to compute final index on dragover — cost O(n) but OK.
Marta: copy tweak idea: change 'Invalid sequencing' toast to 'Rule order must be unique within a group' — current message too vague.
Tyler: Can we also add sim preview: show a temporary 'what-if' view with the rule relocated and simulation traffic percentages at top? users keep asking if reorder affects canary routing.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created issue #4521 for reorder-preview-consistency
Sam: I'll prototype tooltip + insertion line. timeline: 1 sprint? also need aria-live updates for SR.
Lexa: for keyboard: support Ctrl+Arrow to move rule one slot and announce 'moved to position 3 of 5 in Group B'.
Devin: :thumbsup: love the aria text. also add unit test for sequence validation message strings so they don't regress.
Marta: I'll update design mock and microcopy then. Quick sketch in Figma https://figma.com/file/xyz — feedback welcome.
Tyler: prioritize in next minor release. tagging eng-sre if any infra cost. @deploy-bot can you mark priority P2?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: issue #4521 set to P2, assignee: Sam
Sam: thanks, putting spike on my board. will ping when prototype ready :eyes:
